subject: Genetics
title: Where Genetics Goes Next
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Where Genetics Goes Next.

hook.text: Gene therapy. Synthetic life. Genome editing. DNA storage.

buildup.text: Sequencing cost dropped from $3 billion to $200. CRISPR made editing cheap.

discovery.text: AI is now predicting protein structures and gene functions. AlphaFold solved a 50-year problem in biology in months.

twist.text: Access is unequal. Gene therapies cost millions. Poorest nations can't afford genomic medicine.

climax.text: Genetics will reshape medicine, agriculture, and identity.

punchline.text: The code of life is now open source. Who writes the next chapter?

quiz.question: What is the main challenge as genetics advances?
options: Running out of DNA to study
Technology outpacing law, ethics, and access
